title: New models and developer products announced at DevDay
summary: GPT-4 Turbo with 128K context and lower prices, the new Assistants API, GPT-4 Turbo with Vision, DALL·E 3 API, and more.
body: GPT-4 Turbo with 128K context and lower prices, the new Assistants API, GPT-4 Turbo with Vision, DALL·E 3 API, and more.
summaryZh: 在首届DevDay开发者大会上，OpenAI发布了具备128K上下文窗口的GPT-4 Turbo、全新的Assistants API、支持图像输入的GPT-4 Turbo with Vision、以及DALL-E 3 API等一系列重要模型与开发者产品，大幅提升了开发者的构建能力并降低了使用成本。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI在DevDay上发布了GPT-4 Turbo、128K上下文、Assistants API及多模态能力等重大更新。
